scoring_justification: T1 recompute infeasible because the public output schema lacks the intermediate reference energies needed to recompute trapping energies; only the derived values are reported.

outputs.description: Computed ZPE-corrected trapping energies for n=1..6 H atoms in a Si vacancy, along with the ZPE correction and total energy of each configuration.

schema.description: The diffusion barrier for H migration from the trapped state in the Si vacancy to the I-SiC interstitial site.

outputs.description: Energy barrier for H detrapping from the vacancy, computed via CI-NEB.

output_contract.notes: T0 scoring: the checker compares agent-reported trapping energies (n=1..5) and diffusion barrier to paper-reported values with tolerances; for n=6 the trapping energy must be positive. No raw total energy recompute is required.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference gold values for trapping energies (ZPE-corrected) from paper Fig.2, ZPE corrections from Table 1, and diffusion barrier (1.17 eV) from the paper text.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig.2, Table 1, Section 3 diffusion discussion; values extracted directly.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper; ZPE values and trapping energies are the exact reported numbers.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own published results that the reproduction is expected to match within toolchain tolerances.

steps.description: Validate trapping energies and ZPE corrections against paper gold; n=1..5 must match within tolerances, n=6 must be positive.
Validate diffusion barrier against paper value 1.17 eV with tolerance ±0.1 eV.
